About Quillforge

Quillforge, Inc. makes reporting and dashboard software for operations teams. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Austin, Texas. Our Team plan is $49 per user per month and our Business plan is $99 per user per month.

Customers include Larkspur Foods and Tern Logistics.

Quillforge cuts about 15% of staff

Published 2026-09-17. Quillforge, the Austin dashboard maker, said on Wednesday it is laying off roughly 15% of its employees, about 60 people, as it reorganizes around its Business plan. The company did not disclose revenue. Its CEO, Mara Lind, said in a statement that the company "remains focused on profitable growth".
